rca_of_the_issue:
TWO BACKEND BUGS FOUND & FIXED during testing:

BUG 1 (HIGH): PUT /api/admin/password returned HTTP 500 for every valid request. RCA: server.py:461 read `ObjectId(admin['id'])` but get_current_admin (server.py:207-208) sets `user['_id'] = str(user['_id'])` and returns without adding an 'id' key. Result: KeyError → 500 on every password change call. Reproduced by test_rejects_wrong_current & test_change_and_restore. Fix: changed to `ObjectId(admin.get('id') or admin.get('_id'))`. Verified both tests now pass.

BUG 2 (LOW): GET /api/settings returned settings docs without 'categories' key on installs upgraded from iteration 4. RCA: default_settings() (server.py:519) includes categories but get_settings_doc() only initializes settings if the doc is missing — it never backfills newly added default keys on existing docs. Fix: added a diff-and-$set backfill step after get_settings_doc() in seed() that adds any default keys not present. Verified test_settings_includes_categories_array now passes. Note: this fills MISSING keys only; if an admin previously saved an explicit `categories: []`, the empty list is preserved (see minor issue for follow-up).
